title: CDC Division of Media Relations | CDC Newsroom
content: CDC Division of Media Relations Mar. 9, 2026 What to know CDC press officers are here to answer your questions. Please note: CDC experts are working scientists and may not be available for interviews at all times. Contact Media Relations Contact Media Relations Request for Comment Form E-mail Media Relations (if you have a request other than a media inquiry) Phone: (404) 639-3286 For Members of the Media: If you are a member of the media and require information or would like to request an interview, please submit this Request for Comment Form. All non-emergency after-hours requests will be processed between 8:30 am to 5:30 pm EST Monday through Friday. For Others: If you would like to invite a CDC representative to speak at an event, please visit the CDC Speakers Bureau page. Members of the general public who are seeking information from CDC should call 1-800-CDC-INFO (800-232-4636) (TTY: (888) 232-6348) or send a message to CDC-INFO . Leadership Division Director Division of Media Relations Benjamin Haynes Media@cdc.gov Mailing address Division of Media Relations Office of Communications Centers for Disease Control and Prevention 1600 Clifton Rd.
